extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale dataset of real-world long videos with textual annotations, intended to enrich long-video training corpora for multimodal large language models.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was built by leveraging existing long-video datasets and curating them into instruction-tuning QA pairs. The authors generated dense event labels for each long video, used existing high-quality short video captions and event-level annotations where available, extracted major events with an LLM for other datasets, and then constructed long-video QA pairs from captions, event labels, and timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing long-video datasets and their associated captions/event annotations, including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-Vila, and MiraData; specifically short video captions from Panda-70M, CosMo, Ego4D-HCap, and original captions in MiraData, plus event-level annotations from HT-Step and Ego4D-HCap.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For data curation, dense event labels were generated for each long video by using existing high-quality short video captions to construct event labels with corresponding timestamps; for datasets with high-quality event-level annotations, those were directly used as event labels, while for others the major event was extracted from the caption using an LLM. Long video QA pairs were then constructed based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps across five tasks: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Constructed long video QA pairs from video captions, event labels, and timestamps; categorized into five tasks: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Generated dense event labels by filtering consecutive short-video segments that could be regrouped into a long video sequence; used existing high-quality captions and, for some datasets, directly used high-quality event-level annotations; for others, extracted the major event from captions using an LLM.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: For data curation, we generate dense event labels for each long video. Specifically, we utilize existing high-quality short video captions ... and filter the consecutive segments that can be regroup into a long video sequence, then we construct a sequence of event labels with their corresponding timestamps for every long video based on their captions. In this process, for datasets with high-quality event-level annotations ... we directly utilize them as the event labels, while for others, we extract the major event from the caption using an LLM.
